query_notes: Queried Overpass API (overpass-api.de/api/interpreter) against Telangana bbox (15.8,77.2,19.9,81.3). Full-state single combined query timed out (504) with all tag types + way/relation together, so queries were split per element-type and per tag-set and run sequentially (with delays) to avoid Overpass's per-IP rate limit (429 'rate_limited' errors were hit twice on concurrent/rapid requests and resolved by waiting ~10-20s and checking /api/status). Queries run: (1) node/way/relation amenity=place_of_worship + religion=muslim; (2) node/way/relation landuse=cemetery + religion=muslim; (3) node/way amenity=grave_yard (no religion tag exists for this key in the data, so results were post-filtered by name pattern matching for Islamic terms - Khabristan/Kabristan/Qabristan/Masjid/Dargah/Muslim/etc - or dropped if tagged with a non-Muslim religion); (4) node/way historic~'tomb|shrine' (generic historic tag, same post-filter applied since most tombs/shrines in Telangana OSM data are not religion-tagged and this tag also covers Hindu/other shrines); (5) supplementary node/way amenity=place_of_worship with name matching Masjid|Dargah|Khanqah (case-insensitive) to catch mosques/dargahs missing an explicit religion=muslim tag; (6) supplementary landuse=cemetery with name matching Khabristan|Kabristan|Kabrastan|Muslim to catch untagged Muslim graveyards. All result sets were merged and de-duplicated by (osm_type, osm_id). Elements were classified islamic/non-islamic using tags.religion when present, else Islamic-keyword name matching; elements with religion=hindu/christian/buddhist/sikh/jain were dropped. category_guess heuristic: landuse=cemetery or amenity=grave_yard -> graveyard; historic=tomb/shrine, or place_of_worship whose name contains dargah/mazar/roza/astana/khanqah/pir/wali/sufi -> dargah; remaining amenity=place_of_worship -> mosque; anything else -> other. LIMITATIONS: coverage is entirely dependent on OSM community mapping completeness in Telangana, which is uneven - Hyderabad/Rangareddy/Secunderabad are densely mapped, while many rural districts (e.g. Adilabad, Nirmal, Asifabad, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Jayashankar Bhupalpally) have very few or zero tagged sites, so this dataset almost certainly undercounts real mosques/dargahs/graveyards relative to Waqf Board records, especially in rural/smaller-town areas and for graveyards, which are frequently unmapped or mapped without any religion tag in OSM. Some 'historic=tomb/shrine' and 'amenity=grave_yard' entries retained by name-pattern matching may still include a small number of false positives/negatives given the heuristic nature of keyword filtering; manual spot-checking is recommended before treating this as authoritative. Also, the bbox given (15.8,77.2,19.9,81.3) is a rectangle, not the actual Telangana state polygon, so a nontrivial share of results near the edges (e.g. clusters around lat~16.0-16.5, lon~80.5-81.0 and lat~16.0, lon~77.5) likely fall in neighboring Andhra Pradesh or Karnataka rather than Telangana proper; a polygon-based clip against the real Telangana boundary is recommended as a follow-up before treating this as final.
